identity: Stillgrave keeps every grave labelled and every bone accounted for; this season the uncalled dead wander its furrows and a very confused gang is robbing the wrong graves.

quests.title: Furrow Diggers
quests.text: Small Plague Boars root up the {name:dead_furrows} {dir_of:stillgrave:dead_furrows} by day, and every furrow they turn spills somebody's remains. Put down eight; their yellow names mean they only fight back. Someone has been digging in our graves as well, but boars first: they at least leave the bones behind.
quests.lesson: Yellow names are neutral single pulls; keep the meat for the cook.

quests.title: Tools Before Sorrow
quests.text: Make a Wooden Axe and a Wooden Pickaxe and bring both to me. I will check the joints and hand you back a pair that will not split; the dead are patient, but timber is not.
quests.lesson: Basic grid tools; handed-in tools are consumed, the reward replaces them.

quests.title: Wood for the Salting Fire
quests.text: Bring me five logs from any tree outside Stillgrave's warded ground. Salt does the preserving, but the fire under the brine still has to be fed, and it will not eat excuses.
quests.lesson: Any log counts; planks do not. Protected town plants cannot be cut.

quests.title: The Night Gnawers
quests.text: When the light goes, Large Grave Rats take the same {name:dead_furrows} the boars keep by day. Kill eight after nightfall and leave gaps between your fights: a rat in trouble calls its relatives, and it has a great many relatives.
quests.lesson: The night roster of one area; rats answer each other's calls.

quests.title: A Stone Edge
quests.text: Use the wooden pick on plain rock outside town and make a Stone Axe and a Stone Pickaxe. Bring both and I will return a pair; headstones are not for quarrying, so take your stone from the hills.
quests.lesson: Tool progression; check the rock's required pick tier.

quests.title: Coal for the Brine Pots
quests.text: Bring five Coal Lumps from the rock outside Stillgrave, whenever the hunt leaves you a moment. Coal goes in the oven's fuel slot and raw food in its cooking slot; the oven stands by my table.
quests.lesson: Gather while waiting for night; the public oven is in town.

quests.title: Patches for the Shroud Sacks
quests.text: The Large Grave Rats you met in the {name:dead_furrows} drop Rat Fur Patches. Bring me two; the shroud sacks in the crypt store have more holes than shroud. Keep any spares for your own armour enchants.
quests.lesson: Ordinary loot saved from an earlier hunt can be handed in.

quests.title: The Uncalled
quests.text: Braindead Zombies stumble about the {name:barrow_hills} {dir_of:stillgrave:barrow_hills}, day and night. They were never called back properly and nobody wrote down their names, which is worse. Lay eight of them down; these ones were raised on blight soil, so do not wait for the sun to do it for you.
quests.lesson: Red names are aggressive; zombies on blight dirt never burn in daylight.

quests.title: Salt Meat for the Long Rest
quests.text: Bring ten Raw Meat from the boars and rats around Stillgrave. I salt it for the mourners who still eat, and I will send you off with some cooked meat for the road; the living part of you will thank me.
quests.lesson: Meat from earlier hunts counts; cooking is optional.

quests.title: Two Metals for One Bronze
quests.text: Mine copper and tin, smelt them, and bring three Copper Bars and three Tin Bars. You get a Dual Furnace for your trouble; bronze needs both metals in one fire, much like a good funeral needs both mourners and a cook.
quests.lesson: Ores, smelting and the dual furnace for alloys.

quests.title: Teeth on the Blightmoor
quests.text: After dark the {name:blightmoor} {zone_area:blightmoor} fills with Aggressive Grave Rats. They do not wait to be struck, and they bring friends. Kill eight; by day the moor belongs to the Young Gaunt Stags, which mind their own business, so let them.
quests.lesson: Aggressive packs at night next to neutral grazers by day.

quests.title: Crab Legs and Sinew
quests.text: Bring two Crab Legs from the Small Crabs on the {name:saltbones} {dir_of:stillgrave:saltbones} and one Fine Sinew from the Young Gaunt Stags on the {name:blightmoor} by day. The legs go in the broth; the sinew ties the brine sacks shut.
quests.lesson: Two daytime drop requests that share one outing.

quests.title: A Pick for Deeper Rock
quests.text: Alloy three Bronze Bars and bring them to me. I will hand you a Bronze Pickaxe; the rock past Stillgrave gets harder, and so, I am told, does the rest of the world.
quests.lesson: Alloying in the dual furnace; a better pick tier.

quests.title: Borrow Returns Nothing
quests.text: The grave robbers have pitched the {name:robbers_camp} {dir_from_giver:robbers_camp}. Confused as they are, they still dig, and their chief, {name:grave_robber_chief}, keeps whatever they bring up. Drive off six of the Confused Grave Robbers and put an end to Borrow himself; Stillgrave wants its dead back in the right order.
quests.lesson: A camp of aggressive humanoids and a named leader with a fixed spot.

quests.title: The Road to Mournfen
quests.text: Stillgrave is quiet again, which is how we like it. Take the road to Mournfen Village and speak with Mordec Silt; the fen keeps older graves than ours, and it is losing them to the water.
quests.lesson: Travel handoff to the home zone.

quests.title: Repeatable: Deadlands Rat Count
quests.text: Monstrous Grave Rats breed in the {name:deadlands} {zone_area:deadlands} after dark faster than I can count them, and I do count. Kill six and report back; I can post this again twenty minutes after you hand it in.
quests.lesson: Optional repeatable tail of the hunt line.
